meta.name: jacobrakai-honeypot-blocklist
meta.description: Honeypot-confirmed attacker IPs observed against live decoy services (SSH, FTP, telnet, MySQL, VNC): credential-tier entries submitted login credentials repeatedly; scanner-tier entries probed at abusive volume without ever submitting credentials.
meta.inclusion_criteria: two tiers, both requiring real attack activity within the last 30 days: 'credential' = honeypot-confirmed repeated credential-attack attempts (50+); 'scanner' = sustained credential-less abuse, 1000+ connection/probe events in-window
meta.field_notes: tier: 'credential' or 'scanner'. For credential-tier entries, attempts = lifetime credential attempts and bans = ban cycles; for scanner-tier entries, attempts = connection events inside the current window and bans is always 0 — both tiers are firewalled on the sensor, but scanner ban cycles are tracked separately and are not counted in this field. first_seen and last_seen both describe observed attack activity inside the current window, so first_seen <= last_seen always holds. first_banned is bookkeeping — when this IP was first firewalled — and may fall outside the window or after last_seen; it is null for scanner-tier entries.
meta.disclaimer: Provided as-is, no warranty. Entries may involve dynamic or reassigned IPs; verify before acting. Contact the maintainer for delisting.
